mechanism: Both drugs are teratogenic and nortriptyline is metabolized hepatically while isotretinoin causes hepatotoxicity and increases intracranial pressure; combined CNS depressant effects and potential additive psychiatric adverse effects.
action: Avoid combination if possible; if necessary, use effective contraception (isotretinoin requires iPLEDGE), monitor liver function, mood changes, and neurological symptoms; consider alternative antidepressant with lower teratogenic potential.
